about_the_game:
A journey to North Africa. An ancient legend. And a secret that changes everything.

Bryan Scott leads an ordinary and uneventful life – until a mysterious package from North Africa turns everything upside down. Inside: the diary of the missing treasure hunter Kate Williams and a clue to the legendary treasure of the Queen of Sheba.

What begins as a search for a missing woman soon becomes much more: On his journey, Bryan encounters dark secrets, a dangerous secret society – and traces of his deceased father, who once chased the same myth but never found answers.

A journey full of puzzles, intrigue, and adventure – but also full of hope, the past, and the chance to complete his father's legacy.

Players can expect a lovingly hand-drawn point-and-click adventure full of charm, humor, clever dialogue, and challenging puzzles – inspired by classics like Broken Sword.

Game Features

  • Hand-drawn, high-resolution backgrounds

  • Traditional frame-by-frame animation

  • Atmospheric orchestral soundtrack

  • Easy-to-use one-click interface

  • Full voice-over in English and German

  • Subtitles and interface in English and German

Featuring voices by Rolf Saxon & Alexander Schottky, known from Broken Sword
